 GSU takes on Old Dominion in Norfolk
 10/20/2026 11:00:00 AM 
 Share:
 Story Links
 ATLANTA – The Panthers hit the road to face the Old Dominion Monarchs this Wednesday, Oct. 21 at 6:00 p.m. E.T in Norfolk, Va.
 SERIES HISTORY  
This pair will be facing off for the 13 th time since 2007.
ODU dominated the series from 2007 to 2012 only allowing one Panthers win back in 2010. Georgia State won two straight matches in 2022 with one of them being a Sun Belt playoff win in Huntington, WV.
The two teams played in Atlanta last season with GSU securing a 5-2 win.
 SCOUTING THE MONARCHS 
Old Dominion hold last place in the Sun Belt with a 1-4 conference record; they have an overall record of 9-4 in the 2026 season under Head Coach Tennant McVea in his third season.
ODU last played on Saturday, Oct. 17 when they fell 1-5 to UCF in Orlando, Fla.
 STATE IN THE SUN BELT 
Georgia State is 7-5-2 on the season with a 1-3-1 record in Sun Belt play.
The Panthers are red hot and ready to battle for the crown after taking down South Carolina who are ranked No.6 in the NCAA.
GSU saw performances from Virgil Dall'Agnol   and   Joseph Ogwang .
Ogwang got the party started for the Panthers by scoring his first goal of the season off an assist from Dall'Agnol in the first half.
Dall'Agnol secured the Upset for Georgia State with his second goal of the season towards the end of the second half.
Dall'Agnol is fourth in the Sun Belt in total assists.
 UP NEXT 
Georgia State returns home to host the Thundering Herd of Marshall on Sunday, Oct. 21 at 4:00 p.m. E.T at the GSU Soccer Complex.
